name: release-acceptance
description: Use this skill to accept or reject an APM release candidate before tagging: walk the program's critical user journeys (consume, publish, govern) end to end on the exact candidate build, look for broken hints, inconsistent commands, scopes, modes and targets, trust and integrity gaps, upgrade and environment breaks, verify every finding independently, turn each one into a failing-before lifecycle test brief, and return one release-gate row (GO or NO-GO) with evidence. Activate on "red team the release", "acceptance test the RC", "UX acceptance", "pre-release QA", "break the train", "is the release candidate ready", "re-check the findings on the release PR", or before or after cut-release, even when the user does not say "skill". Mode `recheck` re-verifies open findings on a moved head. It never fixes code, opens PRs or tags; reviewing one PR's diff belongs to autopilot-pr-review-worker and writing the tests belongs to apm-lifecycle-tests.
